purpose: Three independent randomized replications of the fixed coupled-learning pipeline; formal evaluation data are not used during training
initialization: Each replication starts new main-road actors and its corresponding frozen passed V14 ego model; V14 models share the earlier declared DQN pretraining ancestor

stage_b.checkpoint: Final sixth actor update, no evaluation-based choice

pipeline_choice: Use the V16 stage2 plus V17 stage1 pipeline. The larger extra V17 continuation is retained as a development attempt, not added automatically or used for checkpoint selection
artifacts: Preserve all stage-A and stage-B states, targets, intermediate weights, source snapshots, budgets, logs and hashes
formal_study: Freeze completed model hashes, gates and a separate test protocol before drawing or running unused final test initials
